text: dsh-grill-first 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的需求澄清插件。它向 DSH 注册 grill_start、grill_confirm 和 grill_research 工具，并注入协议提示与任务门禁：先判断目标、范围、约束和验收标准是否明确，再追问并等待用户确认后放行。它还可保存确认过的需求摘要与偏好，并按需用公开关键词查询 GitHub 候选。适合希望在执行前梳理任务、管理项目偏好或寻找开源参考的用户。无需 API 密钥；调研时会访问 GitHub REST API。

dsh-grill-first clarifies tasks in DSH. It registers tools to assess requirements, ask follow-up questions, and request user confirmation before mutating work. It can save confirmed preferences and search GitHub using public keywords. No API key is required.
想让 DSH 在开始执行任务前先问清目标和范围。
任务描述比较模糊时，帮我分轮追问关键条件。
我希望每次动手前都先让用户确认需求清单。
能不能在需求没确认时限制写文件或运行命令？
希望 DSH 记住用户确认过的项目背景和偏好。
I want DSH to clarify an ambiguous task before acting.
Can DSH ask for explicit approval before making changes?
Help me save confirmed preferences for future tasks.
dsh-grill-first 的功能「需求澄清」：根据任务文本判断目标等信息是否足够；模糊时返回追问方向并记录轮次，明确或命中跳过条件时可放行。 通过对应工具或门禁自动触发。
dsh-grill-first 的功能「确认后放行」：把整理后的需求清单交给用户确认；用户确认后打开任务门禁并保存允许的历史或偏好。 通过对应工具或门禁自动触发。
dsh-grill-first 的功能「未确认任务门禁」：按配置对变更类工具放行、询问或拒绝；只读工具在门禁判断中放行。 通过对应工具或门禁自动触发。
dsh-grill-first 的功能「GitHub 开源调研」：调用 grill_research 后按公开关键词查询最多三个 GitHub 候选，并返回有界的来源信息。 通过对应工具或门禁自动触发。
dsh-grill-first 使用本地 JSON 保存记忆；全局默认位于用户家目录，项目记忆位于工作区下的 .dsh/grill-first。启用调研时会将明确的公开关键词发送至 GitHub API。

dsh-grill-first README · dsh-grill-first：> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：先把模糊任务聊清楚，再确认需求并开工。

[English](./README.en.md) · [配置项](#配置项) · [两层记忆](#两层记忆)

本文描述 V1（1.0.x）。该版本已发布到 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-grill-first) 并推送到 GitHub 仓库。验证情况：173 项自动化回归通过；设置页新增偏好、批量删除均已由用户在真实宿主页面实测成功。宿主登录页面无法用自动化浏览器进入，因此这些页面操作没有截图存档，只有用户实测反馈。

dsh-grill-first README · 使用流程：1. 模型把任务原文交给 `grill_start`，判断目标、范围、约束和验收标准是否足够明确。
2. 对模糊任务只追问影响方案的歧义。默认每轮最多 3 问、最多 3 轮，不必凑满；每轮用 `mode: continue` 记录答案摘要和实际问过的维度。
3. 信息齐全或达到轮次上限后，停止追问，把需求与尚未验证的假设整理成四段清单，交给 `grill_confirm`。**达到上限仍需确认，不会自动放行。**
4. 用户选择「确认，按此开工」后放行本次任务；选择「要改」则修订清单并再次确认。
5. 明确的小任务、命中跳过词的新任务可直接放行。正在澄清时的咨询或追问不会替代需求确认。

例如「把那个页面优化一下」需要先确定页面、优化范围和完成标准。确认清单可以是：

```text
目标：整理登录页视觉
范围：只改样式，不动结构和文案
约束：沿用现有设计规范
验收标准：主要页面在移动端不错位

dsh-grill-first README · 三个工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `grill_start` | 判断是否需要澄清，返回追问方向、轮次、历史答案和 `memory_context` |
| `grill_confirm` | 展示需求清单；明确确认后放行，并按记忆设置保存历史和偏好 |
| `grill_research` | 需求明确后，用公开技术关键词查询开源候选和来源证据；不安装、不执行候选代码 |

`grill_confirm` 优先使用宿主结构化提问。通道不可用或抛错时返回 `needs_user_confirmation: true`，模型应改用内置提问工具展示完整清单，得到用户明确同意后再传 `confirmed: true`。只有**同一会话、相同清单此前实际进入兜底通道**才接受该声明；正常服务可用时直接传 `true` 不会跳过确认卡片。正文超过 6000 字会被拒绝，需要先整理保留全部约束的摘要再确认。

dsh-grill-first README · 门禁模式：| `gateMode` | 需求未确认时 |
|---|---|
| `off` | 不拦截工具；不等于关闭整个插件 |
| `warn`（默认） | 记录日志，允许工具执行 |
| `ask` | 每次变更类调用都请求宿主审批；审批该次操作不会放行整项任务 |
| `strict` | 拒绝变更类调用，直到需求确认或明确跳过 |

门禁仅作用于根 agent。只读工具允许通过；写文件、命令和委派类工具属于受控操作。`ask` 返回审批请求不代表用户已批准；后续变更仍需审批，直到 `grill_confirm` 等合法流程打开任务门禁。

关闭 `enabled` 可停用澄清、门禁与调研。默认跳过词包括「直接做」「跳过提问」「不用问」「skip」；英文按词边界匹配，中文按子串匹配；紧邻关键词的否定表达（如「不要直接做」「don't skip」）不算跳过指令。判定器是中英文关键词启发式，并非完整的语义理解，复杂否定或引用仍可能误判。

dsh-grill-first README · 安装：可通过 DSH 插件管理安装选定版本，或使用命令行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add dsh-grill-first

dsh-grill-first README · 开发构建：使用实际生成的本地包路径：dsh plugin --profile <你的-profile> add /绝对路径/dsh-grill-first-1.0.0.tgz
```

以上为安装方式示例，registry 的默认版本不保证是本文的 V1。以安装结果中的应用状态为准；仓库源码修改不等于运行中的安装副本已更新。

text: dsh-grill-first README · 配置项：V1 提供独立的 **DSH 设置 → 需求澄清** 页面，共 10 项配置，保存到当前插件实例。页面依赖宿主的设置、连接和工作区服务；实际部署后仍需检查页面是否加载与保存成功。

dsh-grill-first README · 配置项：| 配置 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | 布尔 | `true` | 总开关 |
| `gateMode` | `off` / `warn` / `ask` / `strict` | `warn` | 门禁模式，见上表 |
| `maxQuestionsPerRound` | 1–6 | `3` | 每轮问题数上限 |
| `maxRounds` | 1–10 | `3` | 追问轮数上限；达到上限仍需确认清单 |
| `intensity` | `gentle` / `standard` / `grill` | `standard` | 两维 / 三维 / 还要求验收标准的明确度判定 |
| `bypassKeywords` | 字符串数组 | `["直接做","跳过提问","不用问","skip"]` | 命中时跳过澄清 |
| `memoryEnabled` | 布尔 | `true` | 控制澄清流程读取与确认流程写入记忆 |
| `memoryScope` | `project` / `global` | `project` | 项目记忆存工作区或全局目录 |
| `researchMode` | `off` / `auto` / `always` | `auto` | 调研关闭 / 适用时查询 / 每次调用均尝试查询 |
| `researchDepth` | `quick` / `deep` | `quick` | 调研请求预算与摘录深度 |

dsh-grill-first README · 配置项：页面可编辑全部配置，跳过词每行一个。也可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中按插件条目配置；只提供需要覆盖的项：

```yaml
- id: dsh-grill-first
  name: dsh-grill-first
  config:
    gateMode: strict

dsh-grill-first README · 偏好管理：同一设置页支持全局 / 项目偏好的查看、新增、编辑、启停和删除，可编辑文本与标签并查看来源。列表按更新时间从近到久排列，可勾选当前筛选结果批量启用、停用或删除；批量删除需二次确认，中途失败会停止并报告已完成条数。项目范围须选择宿主中已登记的有效工作区。停用偏好不再进入后续摘要；删除前页面会确认。

保存使用 revision 检查并发变更，冲突时重新载入后再编辑；损坏的记忆文件不会被静默覆盖。管理通道仅接受宿主所有者的浏览器，不是模型可调用的偏好写入工具。`memoryEnabled: false` 停止自动读写，设置页仍可管理已有偏好。

dsh-grill-first README · 两层记忆：自动流程仅保存用户确认的需求摘要和偏好，不保存原始聊天记录；设置页也可由用户直接管理偏好。不会另外生成需求文档。

| 层 | 实际默认位置 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 全局 | `~/.dsh/grill-first/global.json` | 全局偏好 |
| 项目 | `<工作区>/.dsh/grill-first/memory.json` | 项目偏好、背景和最近 100 条任务历史 |

设置 `DSH_GRILL_HOME` 可替换全局目录，文件为 `<DSH_GRILL_HOME>/global.json`。`memoryScope: global` 将项目记忆改存同一全局目录的 `project.json`，在项目之间共享；不会改动全局偏好的文件名。路径并非 profile 目录，也没有「不可写则自动换目录」的逻辑。

记忆是未加密的本地 JSON；下次澄清时启用的偏好及项目背景作为 `memory_context` 返回。写入采用同进程串行与临时文件原子替换，不提供跨进程锁。

dsh-grill-first README · 调研模式：`grill_research` 被调用时才执行查询，`always` 不会自行启动后台调研。`off` 不联网；`auto` 要求参数 `applicable: true`；`always` 跳过适用性判断。总开关关闭时调研也关闭。

工具只向 GitHub REST API 发送显式的公开关键词，不读取或上传工作区。一次最多比较 3 个候选，核对仓库元数据、README、许可证与发布信息，并返回来源地址、核对时间和失败状态。`quick` 摘录最多 3000 字、最近 1 个发布；`deep` 摘录最多 12000 字、最近 3 个发布，并提高有界请求预算。

外部文本仅作资料，不能当作指令。许可证 `unknown` 表示未核实，所有候选的许可证兼容性均未评估。超时、限流或网络失败会返回降级结果，可继续本地方案；不会自动安装或执行候选代码。

dsh-grill-first README · 开发与验证：```bash
npm install
npm run build
npx vitest run test/tools.test.ts test/e2e.test.ts
npm test

测试从 `dist/` 导入，因此修改源码后须先构建。限定两组测试验证工具行为与假宿主中的插件链路，不等同于安装后真实 UI 验证。不要用旧版本的测试总数表示当前覆盖率。

运行环境要求 Node.js 20 或以上，宿主提供 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`。V1 还使用宿主连接、设置及工作区服务与客户端设置插槽，兼容性需在目标宿主验证。

dsh-grill-first README · dsh-grill-first：> A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that clarifies vague requests and asks you to confirm the requirements before starting work.

[中文](./README.md) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Two-layer memory](#two-layer-memory)

dsh-grill-first README · dsh-grill-first：This document describes V1 (1.0.x). It is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-grill-first) and pushed to the GitHub repository. Verification state: the automated suite (173 tests) passes, and the user confirmed on the real host page that both adding a preference and batch deletion work. The host login page cannot be entered by an automated browser, so these page operations have no screenshot record, only the user's confirmation.

dsh-grill-first README · How it works：1. The model sends the original task to `grill_start`, which checks the goal, scope, constraints and acceptance criteria.
2. For vague tasks, it asks only about ambiguities that affect the solution: up to 3 questions per round and 3 rounds by default. Each answer is recorded with `mode: continue`, an answer summary and the dimensions actually asked about.
3. Once enough information is available or the round limit is reached, it stops asking and submits a four-part summary, including unverified assumptions, to `grill_confirm`. **Reaching the limit still requires confirmation; it never automatically opens the gate.**
4. “Confirm and start” releases the task; “Change something” leads to a revised summary and another confirmation.
5. Clear small tasks and new tasks containing bypass keywords can proceed directly. Questions and follow-ups during clarification do not substitute for task confirmation.

dsh-grill-first README · How it works：For “optimize that page”, clarify which page, what changes are in scope, and what counts as done:

```text
GOAL: Tidy up the login page's visuals
SCOPE: Styling only; preserve structure and copy
CONSTRAINTS: Use the existing design tokens
ACCEPTANCE: Key screens do not break on mobile

dsh-grill-first README · Three tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `grill_start` | Determines whether clarification is needed; returns focus hints, rounds, answer history and `memory_context` |
| `grill_confirm` | Displays the requirements; explicit confirmation opens the gate and saves history/preferences when memory is enabled |
| `grill_research` | Queries open-source candidates and source evidence using public technical keywords after requirements are clear; never installs or executes candidate code |

dsh-grill-first README · Three tools：`grill_confirm` prefers the host's structured question service. If that service is unavailable or throws, it returns `needs_user_confirmation: true`; the model must show the complete summary through the built-in question tool and obtain explicit agreement before submitting `confirmed: true`. This declaration is accepted only after **the same session and identical summary actually entered the fallback channel**. Passing `true` directly does not bypass a working structured question service. Summaries exceeding 6000 characters are rejected and must first be condensed while preserving all constraints and acceptance criteria.

dsh-grill-first README · Gate modes：| `gateMode` | Before requirements are confirmed |
|---|---|
| `off` | Does not block tools; does not disable the entire plugin |
| `warn` (default) | Logs the unconfirmed state and allows tools |
| `ask` | Requests host approval for each mutating call; approval of one operation does not authorize the whole task |
| `strict` | Rejects mutating calls until requirements are confirmed or explicitly bypassed |

dsh-grill-first README · Gate modes：The gate applies to root agents. Read-only tools remain available; writes, commands and delegation tools are controlled. Returning an approval request is not evidence of approval. In `ask` mode, later mutations still require approval until a valid flow such as `grill_confirm` opens the task gate.

dsh-grill-first README · Gate modes：Set `enabled: false` to disable clarification, gating and research. Default bypass keywords are `直接做`, `跳过提问`, `不用问` and `skip`. English keywords match word boundaries; Chinese keywords match substrings. Immediately preceding negation, such as `不要直接做` or `don't skip`, prevents that occurrence from acting as a bypass. These are keyword heuristics, not full semantic understanding; complex negation and quotations can still be misclassified.

dsh-grill-first README · Installation：Use DSH plugin management to install a selected version, or the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-grill-first

dsh-grill-first README · Development build: use the actual local package path：dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /absolute/path/dsh-grill-first-1.0.0.tgz
```

These are installation examples; the registry default is not necessarily the V1 described here. Check the installation result's application status. Editing repository sources does not update a running installed copy.

text: dsh-grill-first README · Configuration：V1 provides a separate **DSH Settings → 需求澄清 (Requirements clarification)** page with ten options for the current plugin instance. The page needs the host's settings, connection and workspace services; loading and saving must still be checked after deployment.

dsh-grill-first README · Configuration：| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Master switch |
| `gateMode` | `off` / `warn` / `ask` / `strict` | `warn` | Gate behavior described above |
| `maxQuestionsPerRound` | 1–6 | `3` | Maximum questions per round |
| `maxRounds` | 1–10 | `3` | Round limit; the summary still requires confirmation |
| `intensity` | `gentle` / `standard` / `grill` | `standard` | Clarity threshold: two dimensions / three / additionally requires acceptance criteria |
| `bypassKeywords` | string[] | `["直接做","跳过提问","不用问","skip"]` | Matching tasks bypass clarification |
| `memoryEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Enables automatic reads during clarification and writes on confirmation |
| `memoryScope` | `project` / `global` | `project` | Stores project memory in the workspace or global directory |
| `researchMode` | `off` / `auto` / `always` | `auto` | Disabled / query when applicable / attempt a query on every tool invocation |
| `researchDepth` | `quick` / `deep` | `quick` | Request budget and excerpt depth |

dsh-grill-first README · Configuration：All options are editable on the page, with one bypass keyword per line. The profile's `cordis.patch.yml` can also configure the plugin entry; specify only the options to override:

```yaml
- id: dsh-grill-first
  name: dsh-grill-first
  config:
    gateMode: strict

dsh-grill-first README · Preference management：The same page supports listing, adding, editing, enabling, disabling and deleting global or project preferences. Edit text and tags and inspect provenance. Preferences are sorted newest first, and the current filtered results can be selected for batch enable, disable or delete; batch deletion asks for confirmation and stops with a partial-progress report if one item fails. Project preferences require a valid workspace registered with the host. Disabled preferences are omitted from future summaries; the page asks before deletion.

dsh-grill-first README · Preference management：Saves check revisions for concurrent changes. Reload before editing again if a conflict occurs; malformed memory files are not silently overwritten. The management channel accepts only the host owner's browser and is not an LLM preference-writing tool. Turning `memoryEnabled` off stops automatic reads/writes but still permits managing existing preferences on the page.

dsh-grill-first README · Two-layer memory：The automatic flow stores confirmed requirement summaries and preferences, not raw conversations. Users can also manage preferences directly on the settings page. No separate requirements document is generated.

| Layer | Actual default location | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| Global | `~/.dsh/grill-first/global.json` | Global preferences |
| Project | `<workspace>/.dsh/grill-first/memory.json` | Project preferences, background and the latest 100 history entries |

dsh-grill-first README · Two-layer memory：`DSH_GRILL_HOME` overrides the global directory, yielding `<DSH_GRILL_HOME>/global.json`. With `memoryScope: global`, project memory moves to `project.json` in that same global directory and is shared across projects; the global preference filename remains unchanged. These paths are not profile-relative, and an unwritable directory does not trigger a fallback to another location.

dsh-grill-first README · Two-layer memory：Memory uses unencrypted local JSON. Enabled preferences and project background are returned as `memory_context` during subsequent clarification. Writes are serialized within the process and use atomic temporary-file replacement; there is no cross-process lock.

dsh-grill-first README · Research modes：Research runs only when `grill_research` is called; `always` does not start background research. `off` makes no network requests. `auto` requires `applicable: true`; `always` skips that applicability check. Disabling the plugin also disables research.

dsh-grill-first README · Research modes：Only explicit public keywords are sent to the GitHub REST API; the tool does not read or upload workspace contents. It compares up to three candidates, checking repository metadata, README, license and releases, and returns source URLs, check times and failure states. `quick` returns up to 3000 characters of README and one release; `deep` returns up to 12000 characters and three releases with a larger bounded request budget.

dsh-grill-first README · Research modes：External text is evidence, never instructions. A license of `unknown` means it was not verified; license compatibility is not assessed for any candidate. Timeouts, rate limits and network failures produce degraded results so a local solution can still proceed. Candidate code is never automatically installed or executed.

dsh-grill-first README · Development and verification：```bash
npm install
npm run build
npx vitest run test/tools.test.ts test/e2e.test.ts
npm test

Tests import `dist/`, so build after changing sources. The two selected suites check tool behavior and plugin integration in a simulated host; they do not establish installed UI behavior. Historical test counts are not a current coverage claim.

dsh-grill-first README · Development and verification：Node.js 20 or later is required. The host supplies `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`. V1 also uses host connection, settings and workspace services and the client settings slot; compatibility needs verification on the target host.
